issue_context.title: Allow empty responses
comments:
If I'm not mistaken I had the same problem in my old fastify-oas plugin. And as far as I remember the problem is that by default it set the response type to `json` and fastify expects object in that case. 

It might work if you set different content type to request that returns empty response, e.g. `text/plain`.

Imho, this is an issue that has to be solved in fastify core as FST_ERR_SCH_SERIALIZATION_BUILD is thrown when building the validators based on the Schemas. 

See. 
https://github.com/fastify/fastify/blob/61b86760019c85afbef6cc0f175c75870381ed04/lib/route.js#L358

I would recommend to move this issue to fastify core.
Thanks for reporting! Would you like to send a Pull Request to address this issue? Remember to add unit tests.
